items.headline_en: Together Compiler boosts inference up to 3.7x
items.summary_en: Together Compiler uses agents and persistent engines for continual compilation, optimizing open models in under 24 hours and delivering up to 3.7x higher throughput as traffic changes. For users, the practical upside is potentially faster inference as traffic conditions change.
